purpose: R106 threshold 8 exploratory paired low-connection screen; fresh series, no pooling R105.
segment_order: a b b a b a a b
production: Stock C; guarded disposable namespace per window, no installation; all before/after health, boot, config, mounts and identity checks and cleanup must pass.
analysis: Four independent windows, eight ABBA/BAAB segments per lane aggregated into one ratio per side/window. Pilot cannot yield a finite 95% family rank interval for 12 metrics; report all ratios and no equivalence claim.
decision: No runtime acceptance. If >=3/4 own-CPU ratios are adverse and median >1%, this stage fails screening and candidate requires rejection or independent recheck. Report all memory/CPU/latency limits. Low and loaded are separate conditions.
failure_rule: Stop on any collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure and retain failed window. First window also validates new paired tool; if tool changes discard series and freeze new identities/order before restart.
